notes: Layers shown by the Projects > Layers panel and tested by its layer check. The report workflow reads this same file. These are published GIS layers, not the legal plan maps: confirm anything decisive against the operative plan.

layers.name: Protection Management Areas
layers.notes: TRMP Schedule G7A Protection Management Areas.

layers.name: Coastal Management Areas
layers.notes: TRMP Part D coastal management areas. The service describes DC1 Significant Values, DC2 General and DP1 Port areas; the meaning of each MA_TYPE code is still to be confirmed against the plan.

layers.name: Coastal Environment Overlay
layers.notes: TRMP Part C3.14 Coastal Environment Overlay. Checked 8 October 2026: this service returned the same features as Coastal Management Areas (MA_TYPE SVMA). Confirm against the plan maps.

layers.name: Coastal marine area boundary (line)
layers.notes: Lines marking the landward limit of the coastal marine area, not areas. A 'yes' means the boundary crosses the polygon, so part of the site is likely seaward of it, in the coastal marine area. Confirm against the plan maps.

layers.name: Outstanding Landscapes
layers.notes: Outstanding landscapes identified in the TRMP.

layers.name: Scheduled rivers and streams
layers.notes: TRMP Schedules 1, 4 and 6: Aquatic Ecosystem Waterbodies, Outstanding Waterbodies, Watercourses with Ecological Values.

layers.name: GDC parks and reserves
layers.notes: Amenity, heritage, neighbourhood and recreation reserves administered by GDC. Not conservation land.

layers.name: QEII open space covenants
layers.notes: QEII National Trust registered covenants, the same service as Occurd's QEII project. PAN-NZ also includes covenants but may lag behind this source.

layers.name: Land Cover Database v6 (LCDB, 1996–2023)
layers.notes: Current land cover (Name_2023) with earlier mapping dates 1996, 2001, 2008, 2012 and 2018, and a wetland flag for each date. Mapped at about 1 ha minimum; small remnants and wetlands can be missed.

layers.name: Threatened Environment Classification 2012
layers.notes: Built on LENZ Level IV, LCDB4 (2012) and the 2012 protected areas network. Still the current release (checked 8 October 2026).

layers.name: Potential vegetation of New Zealand
layers.notes: Modelled vegetation in the absence of human disturbance. Class names describe the class core; e.g. 'Kauri/taraire-kohekohe-tawa forest' is returned at Tolaga Bay, south of kauri's natural range.

layers.name: Vegetative Cover Map of New Zealand
layers.notes: Historical vegetation cover mapping (1980s). Shows past cover, not current.

layers.name: Protected Areas Network – New Zealand (PAN-NZ)
layers.notes: Legally protected areas: conservation estate, reserves, covenants and others.
